issues.message: Cambridge 页面未取得词条内容，不能承担正文中的具体释义和读音支持。改引已取得的法语维基词典英语词条，并更新所有相关引用。
遗漏原词条明确列出的及物、不及物动词功能。补入两个低频动词义及真实屈折形式；另以低频义补充寒冷相关用法、英美政治义、友军义和蝴蝶名词义。
颜色形容词和颜色名词目前各只有一个例句。补充表语形容词和宾语名词例句，使两个常用功能各有两例。
rainy song 不能自然表达译文中的“忧伤的歌”；原注释也未准确指出 blue 描述的是人的心情。改为 sad song，并修正说明。
“成人内容”范围大于 blue 的色情、下流义；the film was blue 作为海报警示也不自然。收紧释义，换用自然的 blue movie 例句，明确 adult、explicit 的边界，并补充 clean 这一常见反向表达。
a blue + 名词 需要限定为单数可数名词，避免误用于复数或不可数名词。
原句语法正确，但只出现 blew，却关联 blue 的颜色义 s1。改成同时包含 blue 和 blew 的对照句，保留原例句 ID，使 senseId 有明确对应。
两个阶段的 meaning 实际只重复来源关系和传入时间。现有词源摘要足以补出历史颜色范围，无须保留空泛阶段说明。

sourceEvidence.text: English blue came through Old French blo or bleu around the Middle English period. The French forms could refer to pale or discoloured appearances as well as blue or blue-grey shades; early English uses included sky colour and a lead-like colour. The proposed earlier route involves Frankish or another Germanic source. Related ancient colour words do not map neatly onto today’s colour categories, so they should not be forced into a single precise-colour chain.

record.text: English blue came through Old French blo or bleu around the Middle English period. The French forms could refer to pale or discoloured appearances as well as blue or blue-grey shades; early English uses included sky colour and a lead-like colour. The proposed earlier route involves Frankish or another Germanic source. Related ancient colour words do not map neatly onto today’s colour categories, so they should not be forced into a single precise-colour chain.

Early English sky and lead-colour uses
Qualified Germanic route and colour-category boundary
